**[[YPG]] units withdraw from [[Tell Abyad]] and [[Ras al-Ayn]] as the first stage of the [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone|Northern Syria Buffer Zone agreement]] enters into effect. ;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tropical Storm Dorian (2019)|Tropical Storm Dorian]]
**[[Tropical Storm Dorian (2019)|Tropical Storm Dorian]] is expected to grow stronger as it reaches [[Puerto Rico]], the [[National Hurricane Center]] says. [https://www.sun-sentinel.com/news/weather/hurricane/fl-ne-tropical-storm-dorian-update-florida-path-20190827-75d3b5rfnfbmxhvhqkywipabpa-story.html?fbclid=IwAR3sgLrvQoMtcwEHksBXmMzbs07WO9DypYbX1cjOSF-hfQncADVBJKw5uD0 (''Sun-Sentinel'')]
*[[2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires]]
**The Brazilian government through [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro|Jair Messias Bolsonaro]] is open to accepting financial aid from organizations and foreign countries to help fight fires in the Amazon rainforest on the condition that the funds must be under the country's control. [https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/amazon-wildfires-brazil-open-to-accepting-foreign-aid-1.1566951302039 (''Gulf News'')]
*An [[Air China]] [[Airbus A330]] preparing to takeoff as [[Air China Flight 183|Flight 183]] catches fire during boarding at [[Beijing Capital International Airport|Beijing International Airport]]. Passengers and crew successfully evacuate, but the aircraft is severely damaged. [https://simpleflying.com/air-china-fire/ (Simple Flying)]
*A [[Spain|Spanish]] [[CASA C-101|C-101]] military jet crashes into the sea near [[La Manga]], killing its pilot. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/plane-crash-spain-pilot-dead-air-force-francisco-marin-nunez-a9080766.html (''The Independent'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Abortion in Missouri]]
**A U.S. federal judge blocks a [[Missouri]] law banning abortions eight weeks after conception from going into effect. [https://www.thedailybeast.com/missouris-8-week-abortion-ban-blocked-by-federal-judge?fbclid=IwAR16KRp_iyAfMTIaqRTPAg6i65vhBteg7-_NY5l4f1MXy7lO9REBaFS0-vk (''The Daily Beast'')]
*[[Illegal immigration to the United States]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Donald Trump administration]] is in the process of shifting at least $155 million from the [[Federal Emergency Management Agency]] to the [[Department of Homeland Security]], in order to fund the return of some migrants to [[Mexico]]. The move comes as [[Tropical Storm Dorian (2019)|Tropical Storm Dorian]] nears hurricane status as it approaches [[Puerto Rico]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/27/politics/fema-immigration-enforcement-dorian/index.html?utm_source=CNN-News-Alerts&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ICE+to+get+FEMA+fundsf6deda37-364a-4dca-b3d4-8cc1e690b369&utm_term=1c1a3674-f347-0441-0baa-8ee61c704e63&m=d6b08d327e4dcaf19c8d7624ea3f3e1e&p=2019-08-2720%3A06&fbclid=IwAR053QTycMJMaIKsvD-0tRVo0E9C9mH71qw0ViqKNjETx0cMrzyUgIvo5rg (CNN)]
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**[[Russia]]n aircraft leasing firm Avia Capital Services, which has ordered 35 [[Boeing 737 MAX]] aircraft, sues [[Boeing]] in an [[Illinois]] court in the first legal action taken by a 737 MAX customer in the wake of the groundings. Avia seek damages and a cancellation of the order, claiming Boeing were fraudulent, breached their contract with Avia, and negligently introduced design flaws to the aircraft and made negligent representations to the [[Federal Aviation Authority]] seeking the plane's certification. With nearly 400 jets grounded worldwide since March, lawyers representing Avia say they are discussing the possibility of joining the litigation with other companies. [https://www.citynews1130.com/2019/08/27/russian-firm-sues-boeing-over-max-jet-says-defects-hidden/ (CityNews Vancouver)]
*[[2013 Via Rail Canada terrorism plot]]
**An appeals court in [[Ontario]], [[Canada]] overturns the terror convictions of Raed Jaser and Chiheb Esseghaier, citing an error by the trial judge regarding jury selection. A new trial is expected to take place. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49490394 (BBC News)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Nauruan parliamentary election]]
**[[Lionel Aingimea]] is sworn in as the [[President of Nauru]], replacing [[Baron Waqa]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397576/aingimea-chosen-as-waqa-s-successor-in-nauru (Radio New Zealand)]

;Science and technology
* The uncrewed [[Soyuz MS-14]] spacecraft successfully docks with the [[International Space Station]] on its second attempt, with the [[Zvezda (ISS module)|''Zvezda'' module]]. The docking follows the failure of the automated systems aboard the [[Poisk (ISS module)|''Poisk'' module]] with which the spacecraft was originally intended to dock on 24 August. MS-14 carries supplies for the ISS, along with a [[humanoid robot]] named [[FEDOR (robot)|Fedor]]. [https://spacenews.com/soyuz-docks-with-iss-on-second-attempt/ (SpaceNews)] [https://www.space.com/unpiloted-soyuz-ms14-docks-at-space-station.html (Space.com)] 
* [[SpaceX]] executes a successful test of its ''[[Starship (rocket and spacecraft)#Starhopper|Starhopper]]'' vehicle at [[SpaceX South Texas Launch Site|Boca Chica]]. The vehicle was raised 150 metres (490 feet) into the air by its [[methane]]-fueled [[Raptor (rocket engine family)|Raptor]] engine. The engine is planned for use on SpaceX's ''[[Starship (rocket and spacecraft)|Starship]]'' vehicle – a crewed spacecraft capable of [[Interplanetary spaceflight|interplanetary flight]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/jonathanocallaghan/2019/08/27/spacex-launches-starhopper-on-stunning-final-flight-and-takes-a-major-step-towards-mars/#77e238493529 (''Forbes'')] [https://www.latimes.com/business/story/2019-08-27/spacex-starhopper-mars-prototype-test (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Sports
*[[2019–20 in English football]]
**English [[association football]] club [[Bury F.C.]], who were in [[2019–20 EFL League One|EFL League One]], are expelled from the [[English Football League]] (EFL) after a takeover bid to save the club collapses. Fellow EFL League One club and local rivals [[Bolton Wanderers F.C.]] are given an extra 14 days to avoid being expelled due to financial difficulty. EFL executive chair [[Debbie Jevans]] calls the expulsion of Bury F.C. "one of the darkest days in the league's recent history". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/49451896 (BBC News)]
